verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it offers APIs to connect the virtual mailbox to other tools and keep mail and documents in sync. Nothing shows which UI actions the API exposes, such as forwarding, check deposit, junk filtering, multi-user access or AI summaries. Missing for 10: documented API reference, evidence of API/UI feature parity, coverage of specific mail actions (forward, deposit, shred), independent or hands-on corroboration.
